watches.name: Domitor CRKT - Cerekote Titanium Fixed GMT
watches.description: Introducing, the Guild Timepieces Domitor - Titanium Fixed lug GMT Named for the Roman historical use of the word meaning “Conquerer”. The Domitor’s existence is one of pure functionality. A memento for the end user to carry going forth to conquer whatever obstacles they may face with a tool capable of enduring such battles with them. Featuring a matte titanium fixed lug case, elapsed timing 120 click bezel, glossy black (appears matte) C3 lumed dial, C3 lumed white minimalistic handset and indices for ideal and precise legibility, GMT functionality with GMT movement, orange and black GMT hand, 24 hr GMT chapter ring, and 200M of water resistance. Engraved on the case back of the Domitor is the symbol Chi-Rho. The Chi-Rho ( ☧ ) is one of the earliest symbols of Christianity, derived from the first two Greek letters of Christos (ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ), meaning “Christ.” Formed by superimposing the Greek letters Chi (Χ) and Rho (Ρ), it represents Jesus Christ’s victory over sin and death, serving as a sign of salvation, eternal life, and the triumph of divine light over darkness. In the Roman Empire, the symbol gained historic prominence under Emperor Constantine the Great, who, before the Battle of the Milvian Bridge in 312 CE, reportedly saw the Chi-Rho in a vision accompanied by the words “In hoc signo vinces” —“In this sign, you will conquer.” He ordered the emblem placed on his soldiers’ shields and banners, and upon his victory, it became the imperial standard, known as the Labarum. For Constantine, it symbolized divine favor and legitimate rule, merging Roman power with Christian faith. The Domitor serves as an homage of these elden days of strength and masculinity. This project is one that has been at the forefront of our development since Guild Timepieces very inception. We set out to put forth a fixed lug titanium watch that offers the fullest degree of practical functionality for both the professional end user (especially those that do work overseas to have the capability of GMT functionality) and the hard use enthusiast at a price point attainable to all. Each watch is hand assembled in house by Guild Timepieces in the USA, pressure tested in house to ensure water resistance , and each movement regulated in house to put forth the highest quality product in compliance with all specifications. The dial displays our logo at 12 o-clock along with it's namesake in orange, both ATM rating and GMT in white all at 6 O'Clock. Every caseback is engraved with an individual manufactured order serialization Included with each timepiece is choice of a Teardown Systems Ultralight Strap Velcro Ranger Green or a Velcro Coyote strap (both featuring brushed stainless hardware), and a Guild Timepieces X Teardown Systems Watch Caddy Ranger Green and Coyote exclusive colorway case To inquire on having the Domitor made custom Bespoke with your own logo/design, visit our Bespoke page EACH TIMEPIECE IS MADE TO ORDER WITH A FIVE TO EIGHT WEEK FULFILLMENT TIME SUBJECT TO CHANGE - AVERAGE FULFILLMENT TIMEFRAME IS SIX WEEKS All Watch sales Final Includes lifetime Manufacturers Defect Warranty The Domitor by Guild Timepieces Technical Specifications: Watch Model: Domitor Case Size: 42mm (excluding crown) Lug Width: 22mm Serialization: Individual Unit Designation on Caseback in Manufactured Order Water Resistance: 20 ATM (200 Meters) Dial Color: Glossy Black (appears matte) Case Thickness: 13mm Case Lug to Lug: 50mm Case Material: Titanium - Matte Movement: Seiko NH34 GMT, Steel Movement holder Movement Spec: Factory of -20/+40 seconds per day. watches.description: Burn your fleet and settle for nothing less than victory with the Guild Timepieces x Watches Win Wars: Mark WWW The Mark WWW by Guild Timepieces in collaboration Watches Win Wars utilizes the Guild Timepieces Mark V model in a special edition for WWW. Features a Matte Green dial showcasing the WWW Pirate Time logo at the 9-O'Clock on the dial, "WWW" printed in the subtext and "WWW x GT" engraved on each caseback. Included with each timepiece is a two piece rubber strap, a Prevail Outfitters Ultralight Strap in Black with brushed hardware, and a Prevail Outfitters Watch Caddy. Guild Timepieces Mark V Description Introducing, the Guild Timepieces Mark V - Bronze Heritage Diver The Mark V is our pursuit of bringing forth a quality bronze case dive watch inspired by the heritage of the US Navy’s history in diving. The Mark V is designed as a fully capable modern dive watch in a package that is both inspired by some of the greatest tool watches ever known and executed in a manner that stands out from the typical homage. The intent behind the Mark V was to put forth a timepiece that could serve as both a modern diver and tool watch along with being an attainable alternative material, in this case bronze, timepiece. The Mark V’s inspiration stems from the early era of US Navy diving. The Mark V diving helmet, introduced by the United States Navy in the early 1900s. The helmet was used extensively through both World Wars and remained in service for decades. It was an icon of it's time and visually unmistakable today. Combining this with the infamy of the use of Rolex and Tudor Subs in the US Navy’s diving history, we developed the timepiece we have today. The Guild Timepieces Mark V. Featuring a bronze case, elapsed timing 120 click bezel, matte black C3 lumed dial, C3 lumed white snowflake handset and indices for ideal and precise legibility, and 200M of water resistance. The bronze case gives off a gold like tone new out the box and will patina overtime to a darker more worn bronze and potentially develop oxidization on the case. Engraved on the case back of the Mark V is it's point of inspiration, a US NAVY Mark V dive helmet. The Mark V serves as a capable modern alternative material dive watch for the professional, and a noteworthy piece nodding towards heritage in an alternative material for the enthusiast. Each watch is hand assembled in house by Guild Timepieces in the USA, pressure tested in house to ensure water resistance, and each movement regulated in house to put forth the highest quality product in compliance with all specifications. The dial displays our logo at 12 o-clock along with it's namesake and ATM rating in white at 6 O'Clock. watches.description: The Prevail Outfitters Watch Caddy - Guild Timepieces Edition We are extremely proud to offer the Watch Caddy designed and manufactured by our Brothers in Christ at Prevail Outfitters We believe it to be the best in it's class on the market with it's offered feature sets for the price point Having given feedback on the design; it is a product we believe is pushing innovation within the industry A practical means of transporting a secondary timepiece or storing your primary, the Watch Caddy offers an all in one package to store your Guild Timepiece. Featuring dedicated pouches for a spring bar tool (find our spring bar tool sized specifically for the PO Watch Caddy here ), a spare strap, and spare spring bars. Additional feature sets such as the quick view window for fast PID (for those Guild Timepiece collectors with multiple timepieces stored in caddies) and the elastic retention band The Watch Caddy fits easily into a back pocket in a wallet sized package for travel or you watch nerds attending meet ups ready to show off the latest addition from Guild to your collection Prevail Outfitters Description: The Prevail Outfitters Watch Caddy is a adventurers watch companion, designed to take very little space and protect your back up watch while travelling or taking your extra watch to a watch show. It can carry an extra watch, watch strap, spring bar tool and spring bars all within its case. With a really nice feature of a window to see which watch is in the caddy without having to remove the watch from the case. Made with extremely durable materials you won’t have to worry about bumps damaging your watch or your crystal being scratched. All made here in our shop in Ohio with USA made materials. Features & Listing Details: Designed and Manufactured by Prevail Outfitters in Ohio, USA Made of durable American made Cordura Spring bar pouch (located on front flap) Spring bar tool & watch strap pouches (located on back on Watch Caddy) Quick view watch window (accessible by lifting flap without removing flap from retention band) Elastic secure retention band for flap to accommodate most watch sizes Ranger Green and Coyote two-tone colorway exclusive to Guild Timepieces Listing is for one Watch Caddy All sales final Ready to ship | 1-2 Week Fulfillment Timeframe

Combine such with its streamlined dimensions at a 39mm case diameter and 12mm thickness, it offers a wearing experience ideal for the vast majority of end users. Colorways specifically nod to the classic color hues of the P38 Lighting Night Fighter of Black with Yellow contrasting highlights. Featuring a mix of white and yellow patinaed C3 lumed painted indices, polished yellow patinaed C3 lumed hour and minute hands, solid white second hand, and a Black dial with white and yellow subtext. watches.name: Mekong - Black Ops
watches.description: Introducing, the Guild Timepieces Mekong - Black Ops A stealthy nod to the Operational history of the MACV-SOG. The Black Ops edition of the Mekong features a classic matte black dial and black DLC case MACV-SOG: SOG (Studies and Operations Group) later renamed MACV-SOG (Military Assistance Command, Vietnam – Studies and Observations Group) was an elite, secret U.S. special operations unit in Vietnam. SOG conducted high-risk black ops, sabotage, recon, and rescue missions in enemy or neutral territory like Laos and Cambodia. Their missions were classified for decades and remain some of the most dangerous and legendary operations in U.S. military history. This watch is intended to highlight and pay homage to Black Ops operators of SOG, who gave their blood and lives in service to The United States and It’s Allies. Approximate 2,000–3,000 U.S. personnel served with SOG including U.S. Army Special Forces (Green Berets), Navy SEALs, Air Force specialists, CIA operatives, and support staff. Less than 600 service members served at the tactical level. Of those 600 operators half where killed in action with 58 still listed missing in action. We thank them for their service and sacrifice in protecting freedom during the eight-year Secret War. watches.name: Domitor - Titanium Fixed GMT
watches.description: Introducing, the Guild Timepieces Domitor - Titanium Fixed lug GMT Named for the Roman historical use of the word meaning “Conquerer”. The Domitor’s existence is one of pure functionality. A memento for the end user to carry going forth to conquer whatever obstacles they may face with a tool capable of enduring such battles with them. Featuring a matte titanium fixed lug case, elapsed timing 120 click bezel, glossy black (appears matte) C3 lumed dial, C3 lumed white minimalistic handset and indices for ideal and precise legibility, GMT functionality with GMT movement, orange and black GMT hand, 24 hr GMT chapter ring, and 200M of water resistance. Engraved on the case back of the Domitor is the symbol Chi-Rho. The Chi-Rho ( ☧ ) is one of the earliest symbols of Christianity, derived from the first two Greek letters of Christos (ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ), meaning “Christ.” Formed by superimposing the Greek letters Chi (Χ) and Rho (Ρ), it represents Jesus Christ’s victory over sin and death, serving as a sign of salvation, eternal life, and the triumph of divine light over darkness. In the Roman Empire, the symbol gained historic prominence under Emperor Constantine the Great, who, before the Battle of the Milvian Bridge in 312 CE, reportedly saw the Chi-Rho in a vision accompanied by the words “In hoc signo vinces” —“In this sign, you will conquer.” He ordered the emblem placed on his soldiers’ shields and banners, and upon his victory, it became the imperial standard, known as the Labarum. For Constantine, it symbolized divine favor and legitimate rule, merging Roman power with Christian faith. The Domitor serves as an homage of these elden days of strength and masculinity. This project is one that has been at the forefront of our development since Guild Timepieces very inception. We set out to put forth a fixed lug titanium watch that offers the fullest degree of practical functionality for both the professional end user (especially those that do work overseas to have the capability of GMT functionality) and the hard use enthusiast at a price point attainable to all. Each watch is hand assembled in house by Guild Timepieces in the USA, pressure tested in house to ensure water resistance , and each movement regulated in house to put forth the highest quality product in compliance with all specifications. The dial displays our logo at 12 o-clock along with it's namesake in orange, both ATM rating and GMT in white all at 6 O'Clock. Every caseback is engraved with an individual manufactured order serialization Included with each timepiece is choice of a Teardown Systems Ultralight Strap Velcro Ranger Green or a Velcro Coyote strap (both featuring brushed stainless hardware), and a Guild Timepieces X Teardown Systems Watch Caddy Ranger Green and Coyote exclusive colorway case To inquire on having the Domitor made custom Bespoke with your own logo/design, visit our Bespoke page EACH TIMEPIECE IS MADE TO ORDER WITH A FIVE TO EIGHT WEEK FULFILLMENT TIME SUBJECT TO CHANGE - AVERAGE FULFILLMENT TIMEFRAME IS SIX WEEKS All Watch sales Final Includes lifetime Manufacturers Defect Warranty The Domitor by Guild Timepieces Technical Specifications: Watch Model: Domitor Case Size: 42mm (excluding crown) Lug Width: 22mm Serialization: Individual Unit Designation on Caseback in Manufactured Order Water Resistance: 20 ATM (200 Meters) Dial Color: Glossy Black (appears matte) Case Thickness: 13mm Case Lug to Lug: 50mm Case Material: Titanium - Matte Movement: Seiko NH34 GMT, Steel Movement holder Movement Spec: Factory of -20/+40 seconds per day. watches.name: FTD - Titanium Pilot: Interceptor Green
watches.description: Introducing, the Guild Timepieces FTD Titanium Pilot Named after the P38 Lighting Fighter plane of WWII, both feared and respected by the Germans who dubbed it the "Fork Tailed Devil" - hence our modern timepiece in honor of the infamous aircraft/the role it played in the war of our greatest generation, the FTD. Ready and capable for both air and ground operations with it’s highly legible and minimalistic pilot styled dial, fully lumed indices and handset, and ground use rated water resistance at 200m; The FTD comes in ready for whatever use case you have to throw at it. The watch is extremely lightweight (coming in at 45 grams without strap, 58 grams on TDS two piece ultralight strap) and durable with its Titanium case. Combine such with its streamlined dimensions at a 39mm case diameter and 12mm thickness, it offers a wearing experience ideal for the vast majority of end users. Colorways specifically nod to the classic color hues of the P38 Lighting Interceptor of ODG with Yellow contrasting highlights. Featuring a mix of white and yellow patinaed C3 lumed painted indices, polished yellow patinaed C3 lumed hour and minute hands, solid white second hand, and a Olive Drab green dial with white and yellow subtext. Each watch is hand assembled in house by Guild Timepieces in the USA, pressure tested in house to ensure water resistance , and each movement regulated in house to put forth the highest quality product in compliance with all specifications. The dial displays our logo at 12 o-clock along with it's namesake and ATM rating in subtext at 6 O'Clock.
